mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining INDPRO are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
